description: Who owns this company, where does it operate, what does it sell and research?. One company brief joined from five open ledgers: GLEIF group ownership (ultimate parent, descendants, countries), Open Food Facts brand owners (brands, product categories, countries sold, with category market size), OpenAlex research organisations (sites, works, citations by country), public tender notices where the organisation is the buyer, and the home country's cross-border ownership links. Every block names its source and date; matching, country union and summaries are computed by Lilambd. Organisations only, no data about individual people. Routes: /answer (name, lei, wikidata); /brands (q*, limit, offset); /search (q, limit, offset); /coverage. Paid $0.5 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /answer, /brands, /search, /coverage. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.
